Microsoft has done their share to make their platform as friendly to gaming as possible. This also includes a sane, expandable driver model that made adding capable hardware to your computer simple and easy.

Meanwhile, we argued about more important things like which of 10 display managers was best and whether systemd or upstart was better, and why Ubuntu was bad for open source, or which of 200 highly specialized distributions was more appropriate for a given task, or reinventing the wheel with package management systems like pacman and aptitude and portage and yum.
